title: Why The Octopus Basically Has Nine Brains
hook: An octopus has 320 million neurons running its arms, without asking permission.
closing: Data counted his own brains. Still just the one.
question: Want a second brain in each arm?

segments.say: Only 180 million of an octopus's neurons sit in its central brain -- most are out in its arms.
Every one of its 280 suckers per arm is its own touch-and-taste sensor.
A severed octopus arm keeps reacting to touch for up to 3,600 seconds after it's cut off.
